title: XDrip G5, Android 10, Oneplus 7 Pro phone
symptom: During sleeping hours, the phone loses connection to the G5 every night, but connectivity is good during the day. The issue occurs when the phone is not plugged in and not in use for more than about 40 minutes. Restarting the collector via System Status reconnects.
cause: The thread suggests that Android 10's deep sleep or doze mode, possibly combined with OnePlus's aggressive battery saving, is causing the connection loss. The original poster later states that either a phone firmware update or a newer version of xDrip resolved the issue, but no definitive root cause is established.
fix: The original poster reports that the issue resolved after either a phone firmware update or a newer version of xDrip, but no specific fix is stated. A workaround mentioned is keeping the System Status page open in xDrip to guarantee sync.
evidence_quote: Either a Phone firmware update or a newer version of xDrip resolved this issue.
